project.name: FrameContact
project.title: Geometry-aware Partner-specific Antibody-Antigen Modeling under Structural Novelty
project.confirmatory_claim: Intra-chain local-frame geometry plus contact-gated cross-attention improves cognate-partner discrimination on unseen antigen folds, beyond sequence, topology, and marginal-surface priors.

evidence_boundary_at_freeze.prohibited_claim: No existing residue-only or post-access CHIMERA number is confirmatory evidence for FrameContact.

hypothesis.primary: For structurally novel antigens, a cognate antibody-antigen pair receives a higher length-normalized predicted-contact compatibility score than a frozen panel of matched non-cognate partners.
hypothesis.mechanistic: Local-frame intra-chain geometry improves the monomer representation, while explicit contact supervision provides an alignment-free bridge that gates cross-attention between independently framed monomers.
hypothesis.null: Correct and matched wrong partners have equal expected compatibility margin after antigen-fold clustering.

data.development_source: SAbDab2 authenticated structures and exact residue-pair labels
data.contact_label_source: authoritative pairs.parquet only; residue marginals may not be inverted into pair labels
data.contact_candidate_set: complete antibody-residue by antigen-residue Cartesian grid authenticated per instance

split.name: antigen_structure_novel_v1
split.grouping: all instances sharing an antigen structural cluster remain in one role
split.structural_search: Foldseek easy-search with alignment-type 1, audited by reciprocal TM-score columns; TM-align or US-align spot-checks at the decision boundary
additional_hard_constraints: zero exact antigen sequence overlap across roles
zero exact focal antibody sequence overlap across roles
zero PDB biological assembly identifier overlap across roles
no test role used for feature, architecture, threshold, calibration, checkpoint, or seed selection

negative_partner_panel.selection_time: before model fitting from identifiers and training-free metadata only
exclusions: documented multi-specific cognate partner when known
negative_partner_panel.tie_break: ascending SHA-256 of query_instance_id, candidate_instance_id, and protocol seed

primary_endpoint.name: cluster_weighted_cognate_compatibility_margin
primary_endpoint.pair_score: mean of the largest max(1,ceil(0.01 * candidate_pair_count)) validation-temperature-scaled contact probabilities
primary_endpoint.complex_estimand: score(cognate_pair) - mean(score(each of 31 matched wrong partners))
primary_endpoint.aggregate: mean of antigen-cluster means so large antigen families do not dominate
primary_endpoint.success_rule: lower bound of the two-sided 95% bootstrap confidence interval is greater than zero
supporting_retrieval_metrics: top-1 cognate retrieval accuracy among 32 candidates

contact: precision and recall at validation-selected threshold
marginals: epitope mean per-complex and pooled AUPRC
paratope mean per-complex and pooled AUPRC
AUROC, precision, recall, F1, and MCC at validation-selected thresholds
calibration: validation-only temperature before and after calibration
mechanism: attention entropy per layer and head
CA spatial-neighbor attention mass lift over a uniform graph baseline
partner_controls: paratope AUPRC drop after antigen shuffle
epitope AUPRC drop after antibody shuffle
cognate compatibility margin by antigen length, epitope size, continuity, and fold cluster

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize validation cluster-weighted cognate compatibility margin; break ties within 0.0001 by validation mean per-complex contact AUPRC, then earlier epoch
model_selection.temperature_and_thresholds: fit once on validation predictions after checkpoint selection
model_selection.test_loading_time: only after all five checkpoints, calibrators, thresholds, negative panels, and evaluation code hashes are frozen
model_selection.reporting: report every seed and the frozen five-seed ensemble; do not suppress failed or divergent seeds

architecture_matrix: distance plus local direction geometry bias
dense plus zero-gated spatial full-pose path
applicable Pairformer baseline with provenance-locked checkpoint or from-scratch control explicitly distinguished

training_objective.contact: class-balanced BCE on authenticated cognate residue-pair labels
training_objective.marginals: separate class-balanced BCE for paratope and epitope labels
training_objective.specificity: softplus margin ranking loss on cognate versus matched wrong-partner compatibility; wrong pairs are not assigned fabricated all-zero contact labels
training_objective.complex_weighting: each complex has equal total loss weight before the four objective weights are applied

interventions: geometry shuffle while preserving sequence and targets
independent local-frame corruption with fixed CA coordinates
sequence-preserving coordinate perturbation at 0.25, 0.50, 1.00, and 2.00 angstrom standard deviation
independent global SE(3) transforms of antibody and antigen as a required invariance test

external_evaluation.frozen_external_test: must be inaccessible to model selection and opened once through a receipt-gated scorer
external_evaluation.chimera: existing CHIMERA residue-classification outputs are secondary; final integration must run the canonical epitope-conditioned CDR sequence-structure co-design task
codesign_endpoints: complex/interface confidence or DockQ when a reference complex exists
developability filters reported separately from binding specificity

failure_and_claim_rules: A residue AUPRC gain without positive cognate compatibility margin does not support partner specificity.
Attention weights are not reported as contact predictions unless an explicit contact head is evaluated.
One seed, three epochs, a development split, or a post-access split cannot support the confirmatory claim.
A model may be called geometry-aware after invariance tests, but not structurally generalizing until the Foldseek and reciprocal TM-score audit passes.
Canonical CHIMERA co-design performance is not inferred from residue classification.
